text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thanks for adjusting the menu. With this, my legs shouldn't get overly fatigued.
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, did I cram in a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm okay!
...After all, I came here to run.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Trainer-san, you're putting together the race schedule
with my best interests in mind, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta psych myself up more.
And get rid of this fatigue quickly, too."

"...This cannot continue.
For Buena Vista's sake as well, we must re-evaluate her future race schedule..."
